title: Team proposal record v1
description: Written once to .loop/control/team.json by team_configure and never edited afterwards. team_digest is the digest of the normalized config and proposal_id is derived from it, so a later human approval (.loop/control/team.approval.json, a host-signed receipt whose approval_id is proposal_id and whose setup_digest is team_digest) binds exactly this team and nothing else. A changed team is a new proposal that needs a new approval. There is no authorization flag in this record.

status.description: Always PAUSED on disk. Approval is a separate signed receipt, never a field here.
